title: An issue in SKYWORTH DIGITAL CO., LTD SK-WR6640X Wi-Fi 6 Dual-Band Fiber Router (AX1800M) V1.0.3 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive… (CVE-2026-78801)
description: A vulnerability in SKYWORTH DIGITAL CO., LTD SK-WR6640X Wi-Fi 6 Dual-Band Fiber Router (AX1800M) V1.0.3 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information via the hidden_factory_switch.gch file. The issue affects version 1.0.3 of the router firmware. No patch or remediation information is provided. There is no CVSS score available for this vulnerability.
aiSummary: The SKYWORTH DIGITAL CO., LTD SK-WR6640X Wi-Fi 6 Dual-Band Fiber Router (AX1800M) firmware version 1.0.3 contains a vulnerability that permits a remote attacker to access sensitive information through the hidden_factory_switch.gch resource. This exposure could lead to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data. No further technical details or exploitation methods are provided.
aiImpact: The vulnerability allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from the affected router model and firmware version. The exact nature and extent of the sensitive information exposed are not detailed. There is no indication of active exploitation in the wild.
